name: College of Health Sciences
description: The College of Health Sciences provides quality education in health-related disciplines, equipping graduates with the clinical knowledge, technical skills, and professional values needed for effective health care delivery. It offers programs dedicated to promoting wellness and responding to the growing demands of the healthcare industry both locally and globally.
programs: Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN)
Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy
Bachelor of Science in Medical Technology
Bachelor of Science in Radiologic Technology
Bachelor of Science in Physical Therapy

name: College of Computer Studies
description: The College of Computer Studies offers programs in Computer Science, Information Technology, and Information Systems. It prepares students to become competent IT professionals capable of developing innovative software solutions, managing information systems, and responding to the ever-evolving demands of the technology industry.
programs: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science (BSCS)
Bachelor of Science in Information Technology (BSIT)
Bachelor of Science in Information Systems (BSIS)
Associate in Computer Technology (ACT)

name: College of Education
description: The College of Education develops future educators imbued with the knowledge, skills, and values essential for effective and meaningful teaching. It offers programs in Teacher Education across various specializations, committed to producing quality, competent, and values-driven educators who will shape the next generation of Filipinos.
programs: Bachelor of Elementary Education (BEEd)
Bachelor of Secondary Education major in English
Bachelor of Secondary Education major in Mathematics
Bachelor of Secondary Education major in Science
Bachelor of Secondary Education major in Filipino

name: College of Engineering
description: The College of Engineering provides quality instruction in engineering disciplines, equipping graduates with the technical competencies to design, build, and innovate. It offers programs that combine rigorous theory with practical application, producing engineers who are prepared to address the complex infrastructure and technological challenges of modern society.
programs: Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (BSCE)
Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering (BSEE)
Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering (BSME)
Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering (BSECE)
Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering (BSCpE)

name: College of Maritime Education
description: The College of Maritime Education trains students for careers at sea and in maritime industries, with a strong emphasis on commitment, integrity, and competence. It offers programs aligned with international maritime standards, producing officers and maritime professionals ready for global deployment aboard merchant vessels and in shore-based maritime operations.
programs: Bachelor of Science in Marine Transportation (BSMT)
Bachelor of Science in Marine Engineering (BSMarE)
Bachelor of Science in Customs Administration (BSCA)

name: College of Business and Accountancy
description: The College of Business and Accountancy prepares students for dynamic careers in business, management, and accounting. Grounded in ethical and professional standards, it offers programs in Business Administration, Accountancy, and Entrepreneurship, developing graduates who are analytically sharp, globally competitive, and socially responsible leaders in commerce and industry.
programs: Bachelor of Science in Accountancy (BSA)
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration major in Marketing Management
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration major in Financial Management
Bachelor of Science in Business Administration major in Human Resource Management
Bachelor of Science in Entrepreneurship (BSEntrep)

name: College of Arts and Sciences
description: The College of Arts and Sciences provides a broad liberal education in the humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences. As the foundational college of the university, it fosters critical thinking, cultural awareness, and scientific literacy, preparing students with a well-rounded education that underpins all academic disciplines and professional pursuits.
programs: Bachelor of Arts in English Language Studies
Bachelor of Arts in Political Science
Bachelor of Arts in Psychology
Bachelor of Science in Biology
Bachelor of Science in Mathematics
Bachelor of Science in Social Work

name: College of Criminology
description: The College of Criminology prepares students for careers in law enforcement, crime prevention, and criminal investigation. The program develops professionals with sound knowledge of criminological theories, forensic science, and legal procedures, committed to upholding justice, public safety, and the rule of law in service of the community.
programs: Bachelor of Science in Criminology (BSCrim)
